jq.name: callback, receipt and closure sources are scoped to this pack and correlate by work unit
jq.expr: (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-workspace") | .correlation_field == "work_unit_id" and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-write") | .correlation_field == "work_unit_id" and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-review") | .source_collection == "WorkspaceReceipt" and .workspace_authority == "readOnly" and .correlation_field == "work_unit_id" and (.filter | contains("writer")) and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-record") | .source_collection == "FireOutcome" and .correlation_field == "source_handoff_id" and (.filter | contains("completed")) and (.filter | contains("change-unit-integrate")) and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and ([.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-integrate" or .event_source_id == "change-unit-rejected") | (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))] | all)

jq.name: review cannot accept blocked work and compares native receipt paths
jq.expr: (.assets["tasks/change_unit_review_task/prompt.md"] | contains("status `blocked` can never be accepted") and contains("every path in the native receipt's `changed_files` to be a member") and contains("implementation's `changed_files` claim to match the native receipt's complete changed-path set exactly")) and (.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-record-io") | any(.entries.entries[]; .tool_name == "read_change_unit_review" and .collection == "ChangeUnitReview")) and (.assets["tasks/change_unit_record_task/prompt.md"] | contains("review verdict must be `accepted`") and contains("writer receipt id, and seal hash must match the closure")) and (.assets["README.md"] | contains("\"status\":\"ready\""))

jq.name: approval persists exact writer receipt and seal
jq.expr: .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-review-io") | any(.entries.entries[]; .tool_name == "write_change_unit_closure" and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "writer_receipt_id" and .fill.source_field == "receipt_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "writer_seal_hash" and .fill.source_field == "seal_hash")))

jq.name: integration is acknowledgement-only and serialized
jq.expr: (.config.triggers[] | select(.trigger_id == "change-unit-integrate") | .concurrency == "queued_serial") and (.assets["tasks/change_unit_integrate_task/prompt.md"] | contains("host owns serial ApplyDiff integration") and contains("Do not inspect or edit files"))

jq.name: atomic stages expose outcomes without routing workers into supervisor sessions
jq.expr: ([.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "change-unit-writer-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-review-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-integrate-task") | .emit_outcome == true and .goal_objective_template == null] | all) and ([.config.triggers[] | .session_id_template == null] | all) and ([.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "change-unit-record-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-rejected-task") | (.emit_outcome // false) == false] | all)
